responsibility: Implements the M32C backend’s block and string move/set/compare machine descriptions, defining how GCC expands memcpy/memset/strcmp/strcpy-style operations into the target’s string instructions. It provides expanders and insns for cpymemhi, setmemhi, cmpstrsi, and movstr, modeling address-register updates, count register consumption, and special A16 versus A24 behavior for SMOVF/SSTR/SCMPU/SMOVU-based sequences.
